topic: Male Reproductive System Parts and Functions
key_concepts: Testes produce sperm cells and male sex hormones
Scrotum holds and protects the testes at a slightly lower temperature
Penis deposits sperm into the vagina
Urethra serves as passageway for both sperm and urine
Epididymis stores mature sperm and enables sperm to move
Vas deferens is the passageway of sperm cells from the testes
Prostate gland secretes fluid that neutralizes vaginal acidity and aids sperm motility
Cowper’s gland secretes lubricating and urine-neutralizing fluid
Seminal vesicle produces sugar-rich fluid that provides energy for sperm motility
Sperm cell is the male reproductive sex cell
Male reproductive system produces sperm and delivers them to the female reproductive syste
